method: spend = input + cache_creation + output per unique message id in the runtime subagent transcript; cache_read reported, never added; content NOT read; a group of attempts sharing an agent is counted once; an attempt with no transcript keeps its recorded figure (v3 method)
limits: an execution with no receipt and no map entry is invisible here; the orchestrator's own context spend is not counted (the ceiling is subagent tokens); the map-without-receipt spend is reported beside the bound and NOT added to it until each is attributed
tier: MEASURED for every transcript figure; recorded figures keep the tier their receipts state
